def transforms(mask):
    n=len(mask)
    m=[[1 if ch=='#' else 0 for ch in row] for row in mask]
    def key(g): return ''.join(''.join(str(v) for v in row) for row in g)
    def rot(g): return [[g[n-1-c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    def mir(g): return [list(reversed(row)) for row in g]
    out={}; g=m
    for k in range(4):
        out['r%d'%(k*90)]=key(g)
        out['r%dm'%((k*90)%360)]=key(mir(g))
        g=rot(g)
    return out
